motion_cleanup_analyze.description:
Read legacy diagnostic summaries; these are not canonical quality acceptance.

    Legacy values retain their original units and mapping conventions. An
    explicit profile/context/intent can constrain capture, but these summaries
    do not certify dependency coverage, original intent, or collision quality.
    Use finite recipes for measured canonical acceptance. Segments are inclusive
    frame pairs; arms and hands remain optional diagnostics.
motion_cleanup_analyze.name: motion_cleanup_analyze

motion_cleanup_prepare.description:
Prepare a canonical whole-clip candidate with explicit rig, units, intent and support data.

    parameters holds SI limits, verified interpolation metadata, rig calibration
    and optional geometry tracks. supports supplies observed support transforms.
    Contact repair preserves the declared root trajectory; steps defaults false.
    Unavailable coverage or native adapters are returned as blocked/unsupported.
    Predicted metrics remain separate from actual post-commit quality.
motion_cleanup_prepare.name: motion_cleanup_prepare
